treatments.name: Cardiac bypass (CABG)
treatments.description: Revascularisation of blocked coronary arteries using arterial/venous grafts. Off-pump and minimally invasive options available at partner centres.

faqs.q: How long before I can fly back?
faqs.a: Most patients fly home at day 10–14 post-op with a fit-to-fly certificate. Your surgeon signs off after a repeat echo and wound check.

faqs.q: Will my reports be reviewed before I commit?
faqs.a: Yes — upload your angiogram/CT and creatinine; two partner surgeons review and send a provisional plan free of charge.

faqs.q: What if I need a re-operation?
faqs.a: All EthAum partner hospitals offer a 90-day complication cover; we coordinate the revision at no extra cost and re-book your travel.

treatments.name: Knee replacement (TKR)
treatments.description: Total knee replacement with robotic alignment planning; partial (UKR) options for unicompartmental disease. Implant brand and sizing disclosed up front.
treatments.recovery: Walking next day · 6 weeks to stairs
treatments.bestFor: Severe OA · failed PRP/hyaluronic acid · deformity

faqs.q: How robotic differs from conventional?
faqs.a: Robotic arms cut to sub-millimetre precision, preserving ligaments and speeding recovery — ask your surgeon for your alignment plan.

faqs.q: Knee vs hip — which ages better?
faqs.a: Both last 20–25 years with good physiotherapy; robotic TKR typically reports slightly faster early recovery.

treatments.name: IVF (own eggs)
treatments.description: Full cycle: stimulation monitoring, egg retrieval, ICSI, blastocyst culture and fresh/frozen transfer. Donor and surrogacy pathways on request.
treatments.bestFor: Unexplained infertility · mild male factor · PCOS

faqs.q: Success rates at partner centres?
faqs.a: Own-egg cycles under-35 range 54–61% per transfer across partners; we publish per-centre data in the quote.

faqs.q: How long should we stay?
faqs.a: Plan 12–16 days for retrieval + transfer. Freeze-all cycles need one visit; FET can be done back home.

treatments.name: Dental implants
treatments.description: Titanium implants with digital guided surgery; crowns in zirconia. All-on-4/6 full-mouth rehabilitations in 5–7 days.
treatments.bestFor: Missing teeth · failing bridges · full-mouth rehab
included: Lifetime crown adjustment at any EthAum partner

faqs.q: Can I get permanent teeth in one trip?
faqs.a: Full-arch All-on-4/6 in 5–7 days yes; single implants need a 3–4 month healing visit or a provisional now + final later.

treatments.name: Hair transplant (FUE)
treatments.description: Micro-FUE with sapphire blades, DHI options for hairline refinement, and unshaven FUE. Graft counts counted and disclosed per session.
treatments.recovery: Desk work in 3 days · shedding week 2

faqs.q: How many grafts do I need?
faqs.a: Send us photos front/sides/top/crown — our team sends an indicative graft count within 48h.

treatments.name: Gastric sleeve
treatments.description: Restrictive bariatric surgery with leak protocol and 6-month dietitian program. BMI ≥ 32.5 with comorbidities or ≥ 37.5 otherwise.
treatments.recovery: Drive in 10 days · full diet week 6

faqs.q: Am I eligible?
faqs.a: Send BMI + comorbidity profile; our coordinators and two partner surgeons confirm eligibility candidly — including telling you not to travel if surgery won't help.

treatments.name: Cataract (multifocal)
treatments.description: Day-care phaco surgery with monofocal, toric or trifocal IOLs. Femto-assisted option; same-week second-eye surgery.
treatments.bestFor: Significant visual loss · glare at night · presbyopia

faqs.q: Which lens should I pick?
faqs.a: If you rarely read glasses and hate them, trifocal/extended-range; if you drive at night daily, monofocal + readers is safer. Surgeon advises after biometry.

treatments.name: Oncology — PET-CT & biopsy
treatments.description: PET-CT, targeted biopsy (CT/USG/bronchoscopy), MDT review and a written treatment plan — surgery, chemo, IO or watchful waiting.
treatments.bestFor: New cancer diagnosis · staging · recurrence check

faqs.q: Can I get a second opinion without travelling?
faqs.a: Yes — upload scans; the MDT reviews and replies in 7 working days. Only travel if the plan changes or biopsy is needed.

treatments.name: Hip replacement
treatments.description: Total hip replacement with muscle-sparing anterior approach; ceramic or dual-mobility bearings for younger patients.
treatments.bestFor: Avascular necrosis · OA hip · fracture neck of femur

faqs.q: Which approach is best?
faqs.a: Anterior = fastest recovery, best for slim fit patients; posterior = versatile for obese/complex anatomy. Your surgeon decides after CT.

treatments.name: Angioplasty + stent
treatments.description: Balloon angioplasty with DES implantation; IVUS-guided optimisation at partner centres. Single and multi-vessel disease.

faqs.q: Stent vs bypass?
faqs.a: One or two vessel disease → angioplasty; left-main or triple-vessel with diabetes → CABG. Your angiogram decides.

treatments.name: Gastric bypass (RNY)
treatments.description: Malabsorptive-restrictive bypass for BMI ≥ 37.5 or uncontrolled diabetes with metabolic syndrome. Revisional cases considered.

faqs.q: Sleeve vs bypass?
faqs.a: Sleeve for restriction, bypass for reflux/diabetes or very high BMI. MDT decides from your pH study and HbA1c.

treatments.name: LASIK / SMILE
treatments.description: Bladeless LASIK and SMILE pro for myopia up to -10D. Femtosecond laser, iris registration. Both eyes same day.

faqs.q: LASIK vs SMILE?
faqs.a: SMILE = smaller incision, drier-eye friendly, no flap — preferred for athletes and dry eyes. LASIK = faster visual recovery.

treatments.name: Kidney transplant
treatments.description: End-to-end transplant pathway: recipient and donor work-up, cross-match review, nephrectomy plus implantation, and 12 weeks of immunosuppression titration with one named transplant coordinator.

faqs.q: How are donor and recipient matched?
faqs.a: Cross-match, blood-group and HLA antibody screens are reviewed by the transplant team before any date is offered. If the pairing is weak, the coordinator says so instead of booking.

faqs.q: How long do we need to stay?
faqs.a: Plan 18–24 days in country for the operation, the first dressing change and the initial immunosuppression review; the rest of the protocol runs remotely.

treatments.name: Robotic prostatectomy
treatments.description: Robot-assisted radical prostatectomy with a nerve-sparing approach, intraoperative margin assessment and a 48-hour discharge pathway, including a written continence and potency plan.
treatments.recovery: Catheter 7 days · desk work in 3 weeks
treatments.bestFor: Prostate cancer · PSA <30 · fit for surgery
included: MRI + PSA + biopsy review by the surgeon

faqs.q: Will I keep urinary control afterwards?
faqs.a: Early continence varies. The surgeon sends a written expectation based on your pre-operative assessment, and the package includes a 12-week pelvic-floor physiotherapy plan.

faqs.q: When is the PSA result available?
faqs.a: The final pathology report is usually ready by day 7–10 after surgery and is explained in a video call before you fly home.

treatments.name: Liver transplant
treatments.description: Deceased-donor liver transplantation for end-stage liver disease and select liver cancers, with MELD scoring, ICU stay planning and a 6-month rehabilitation pathway.
treatments.bestFor: Decompensated cirrhosis · MELD 15–30 · HCC within criteria
included: MELD / Child-Pugh scoring + transplant board review
ICU stay + ward stay, 21 nights included
Flights for 3 travellers · visa · hospital transfer

faqs.q: Is a transplant always possible?
faqs.a: No. The transplant board applies published criteria and often declines — when that happens the coordinator shares the reasoning and, where relevant, a liver-cancer or cirrhosis-management plan instead.

faqs.q: Who stays with the patient?
faqs.a: One companion is included for the whole admission. Because the ICU phase is unpredictable, we advise one family member who can travel at short notice.

treatments.name: Varicose vein ablation
treatments.description: Duplex-guided endovenous laser ablation with triphlex ultrasound, usually completed as a single day-care visit with compression therapy and a remote wound check.
treatments.recovery: Walking the same day · compression for 3 weeks
treatments.bestFor: Varicose veins · skin changes · recurrent aching
included: Day-14 scan review with the vascular team

faqs.q: Do I need to stay in hospital?
faqs.a: Most patients are treated as day-care and fly or drive home the same evening; the quote shows the exact day-care pathway before you commit.

faqs.q: How soon do the veins disappear?
faqs.a: Most visible veins fade over 6–12 weeks as the treated vein closes and the circulation re-routes — progress photos are tracked at day 14 and day 60.

treatments.name: Sinus & septal surgery
treatments.short: FESS endoscopic sinus surgery with septoplasty
treatments.description: Functional endoscopic sinus surgery with septoplasty and turbinate reduction for chronic rhinosinusitis, nasal polyps and long-standing obstruction, including allergy work-up.
treatments.bestFor: Chronic sinusitis · polyps · blocked nose for years
included: CT of PNS + nasal endoscopy + allergy panel
1 night room + nasal pack removal at day 5
Steroid and saline protocol for 6 weeks

faqs.q: Is the pack removal painful?
faqs.a: The pack is removed on day 5 in clinic; most patients describe it as uncomfortable rather than painful, and you can fly home 24 hours later.

faqs.q: Will my sense of smell return?
faqs.a: Smell often improves within weeks of clearing the sinuses, but patients with long-standing polyps may need a second opinion on smell training and steroid therapy.

treatments.name: Laparoscopic hernia repair
treatments.description: Keyhole mesh repair (TAPP or TEP) for inguinal or incisional hernia with same-day discharge, an explicit no-heavy-lifting protocol and remote wound reviews.
treatments.bestFor: Groin or incisional hernia · reducible swelling · fit for surgery

faqs.q: Mesh or no mesh?
faqs.a: Mesh repair has the lower recurrence rate and is standard for most inguinal hernias; the surgeon confirms the approach and the mesh brand in writing before you travel.

faqs.q: When can I fly home?
faqs.a: Most patients fly 2–3 days after surgery once the driver is dry and pain is oral-only — your fit-to-fly note is issued on day 2 or 3.

faqs.q: Is EthAum a hospital or an agency?
faqs.a: Neither — we are a patient-first marketplace. We coordinate; accredited hospitals treat. You always sign consent with the hospital, not with us.

faqs.q: How much does EthAum charge me?
faqs.a: Nothing. Hospitals pay us a referral fee, disclosed in every quote. Your quote is identical whether you book via us or direct — and ours is usually lower because we bundle.

faqs.q: Are partner hospitals really JCI/NABH?
faqs.a: Yes — certificates are verified quarterly; scan any hospital's profile to see the certificate number and expiry.

faqs.q: What does 'all-in' actually include?
faqs.a: Procedure + anaesthesia + room nights + surgeon/implant (branded) + airport pickup + visa letter + companion stay + day-7/30/90 tele-follow-ups. Flights are added at your actual fares.

faqs.q: Can I pay in instalments?
faqs.a: Yes — 0% EMI for 6 months or 12% reducing thereafter; or pay the hospital directly at admission; or insurance cashless where networked.

faqs.q: Do you share my medical records with hospitals?
faqs.a: Only the hospitals you tap 'Request quote' on, only after you e-sign consent. Records are AES-256 encrypted, stored in India (DPDP) and never sold.

faqs.q: What if the surgery is cancelled after I travel?
faqs.a: You get 100% of the EthAum-coordinated costs refunded, flights rebooked, and our coordinator stays with you. Hospitals owe equivalent credits.

faqs.q: Can I travel with one companion?
faqs.a: Yes — quotes include one companion (room + meals + transfers). Extra companions at cost; we flag this clearly.

faqs.q: Halal / jain / gluten-free meals?
faqs.a: All partners mark meal plans in the patient file; your coordinator confirms 48h before admission.

faqs.q: How long is recovery before I can fly?
faqs.a: Procedure-specific: CABG day 10–14, TKR day 7, IVF retrieval same-day, LASIK next day. Your surgeon issues the fit-to-fly.

faqs.q: Is there Wi-Fi / Indian SIM in the hospital?
faqs.a: All partners: free Wi-Fi + a pre-loaded local SIM for the companion delivered at pickup.

faqs.q: What if I need ICU beyond the quoted days?
faqs.a: Quoted quotes include standard ICU 2d; extra days at pre-agreed capped rates (in the consent), never open-ended.

faqs.q: Can I get my reports reviewed before committing?
faqs.a: Yes — every case gets free pre-quote review by two partner surgeons. No obligation, no payment.

faqs.q: Do you help with medical visas?
faqs.a: Yes — India e-Medical visa, Thailand on-arrival, Turkey e-Visa, Malaysia visa-free: we file, track and print everything.

faqs.q: What languages do coordinators speak?
faqs.a: English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, Marathi, Arabic, Turkish, Thai, Mandarin and Bahasa.

faqs.q: Are reviews on EthAum verified?
faqs.a: Yes — every review is written by a patient whose treatment we coordinated; hospital and procedure are cross-checked before publishing.

faqs.q: Can EthAum book my flights and hotel?
faqs.a: Yes — bundled at net fares; or book yourself and just use our transfer desk. Your call.

faqs.q: What if I'm not happy with the outcome?
faqs.a: First: your coordinator + surgeon speak within 24h. If unresolved, EthAum's patient ombudsman reviews — we have resolved 11 disputes, 9 in patient's favour.

faqs.q: Is my money safe paying in advance?
faqs.a: Token ₹9,999 only — refundable within 48h, held by EthAum escrow, never by the hospital until you check in.

faqs.q: Do you cover post-return complications?
faqs.a: 90-day complication window: one tele-review + one local scan review covered; travel revision at cost, insurance accepted.

faqs.q: Can I donate organs through this platform?
faqs.a: No — we do not facilitate organ donation or surrogacy in unregulated markets. Only lawful, licensed pathways in India/Thailand/Malaysia with documentation.

faqs.q: What about ayurveda / integrative care?
faqs.a: We coordinate classical Panchakarma at NABH-accredited centres as adjunct, never as a replacement for indicated surgery/chemo.

faqs.q: How long does quote collection take?
faqs.a: Median 31 hours; the fastest is 4h (dental/hair). If a hospital doesn't respond in 72h we drop and add another.

faqs.q: Can I request a female surgeon?
faqs.a: Yes — flag it in your case; 60% of our partner gyn/cardiac teams can accommodate.

faqs.q: Is EthAum a hospital or an agency?
faqs.a: Neither — we are a patient-first marketplace. We coordinate; accredited hospitals treat. You always sign consent with the hospital, not with us.

faqs.q: How is the hospital index built?
faqs.a: Eight institutions are hand-audited by our clinical desk and carry verified accreditation, outcome and patient-experience data. The wider index is a scale model of the marketplace and its entries are illustrative demo listings, not audited providers.

faqs.q: Can I see a hospital's audit before I enquire?
faqs.a: Yes for audited institutions — accreditation numbers, expiry dates and the last audit date sit on each profile. Index listings do not yet have an audit pack, and we label them as such.

faqs.q: Do I need a referral from my local doctor?
faqs.a: No. Many patients arrive without one. We do ask for recent reports, and your case is reviewed by a surgeon before you travel so nobody books a flight for the wrong procedure.

faqs.q: What if I am not sure which treatment I need?
faqs.a: Start a case with your symptoms and reports instead of a procedure. The clinical desk replies with what the evidence suggests and which specialities to compare.

faqs.q: Can I pay in instalments?
faqs.a: Yes — 0% EMI for 6 months or 12% reducing thereafter; or pay the hospital directly at admission; or insurance cashless where networked.

faqs.q: Are the prices on treatment pages binding?
faqs.a: No. Every figure is an indicative all-in band. The written quote you accept is the binding one, and it holds for 30 days including implants.

faqs.q: What is not included in an all-in quote?
faqs.a: Flights are added at your actual fare, personal spending is yours, and any extra nights you choose to keep are billed at the pre-agreed capped rate in your consent.

faqs.q: Do you charge a booking fee?
faqs.a: Only a refundable token of ₹9,999, held in escrow until you check in. Hospitals pay the referral fee, and it is disclosed inside every quote.

faqs.q: Can I compare a quote against a private hospital at home?
faqs.a: Yes. Every treatment page shows the private-India saving so you can sanity-check the number before you talk to anyone.

faqs.q: How do you verify a doctor?
faqs.a: Original registration certificates, the hospital employment letter and a log of recent cases are checked before a profile is published, and again every year.

faqs.q: What if a hospital stops meeting your standard?
faqs.a: It is delisted from the audited set the same quarter it fails, and patients with a booked case are re-matched by the clinical desk at no cost.

faqs.q: Can I talk to a patient who went to the same centre?
faqs.a: For audited institutions, yes, after you have shared your treatment plan with the coordinator and the patient has consented to the call.

faqs.q: Are outcome statistics per surgeon or per hospital?
faqs.a: Both are published separately for audited centres, and we never mix a hospital's overall figures into a single surgeon's record.

faqs.q: Do index listings come with outcome data?
faqs.a: No. Index entries are scale listings in this demo build; they show structure, not verified clinical performance, and we mark them accordingly.

faqs.q: Who can see my medical records?
faqs.a: Only the hospitals you request a quote from, only after you e-sign consent. Records are encrypted, stored under DPDP and never sold.

faqs.q: Can my employer or insurer see my case?
faqs.a: Only if you name them. You can add an insurer later — most policies need the hospital's invoice and discharge summary rather than our notes.

faqs.q: How long do you keep my files?
faqs.a: Until you ask us to delete them, and then within 30 days across primary stores and backups, with a written confirmation.

faqs.q: What if the surgery is cancelled after I travel?
faqs.a: You get 100% of the coordinated costs refunded, flights rebooked, and your coordinator stays with you until a new date is confirmed.

faqs.q: What if I need ICU beyond the quoted days?
faqs.a: Quoted packages include standard ICU days. Extra days are billed at pre-agreed capped rates in your consent, never open-ended.

faqs.q: Who is responsible if something goes wrong?
faqs.a: Clinical responsibility stays with the treating hospital and its clinician. We coordinate, we do not practise medicine, and we make sure the consent, the escalation route and the insurer are all in place before admission.

faqs.q: Do you screen for pre-travel health risks?
faqs.a: Yes. We ask about mobility, cardiac history, diabetes control and recent infections, and we flag cases where flying is genuinely unsafe.

faqs.q: How long do I need to stay in the country?
faqs.a: It depends on the procedure — day-care for dental, cataract and vein work, 10–14 days for a bypass, 3–6 months for a transplant rehabilitation path.

faqs.q: Can my companion travel with me?
faqs.a: Yes — quotes include one companion for room, meals and transfers. Extra companions are priced separately and shown as a separate line.

faqs.q: What about meals if I have dietary requirements?
faqs.a: All partner hospitals mark meal plans in the patient file, and your coordinator confirms them 48 hours before admission.

faqs.q: Do you arrange airport transfers and a driver?
faqs.a: Yes, on every quote that includes a hospital stay. The driver's number is shared with your coordinator, not with a call centre.

faqs.q: Can I extend my stay for a holiday?
faqs.a: Usually, yes. The medical part of the quote is fixed; you book the extra nights directly with the hospital and we help with the visa extension paperwork.

faqs.q: Who follows me up when I get home?
faqs.a: A named coordinator runs the day-7, day-30 and day-90 tele-reviews, and local scans are reviewed remotely by the treating team.

faqs.q: What if I need physiotherapy after I fly home?
faqs.a: Your package includes a video-based physiotherapy plan with a local partner clinic for hands-on sessions where they are needed.

faqs.q: How do I know a wound is healing normally?
faqs.a: You get a written day-by-day checklist with photos, and a direct line to the surgical team if anything looks different from it.

faqs.q: Can I fly home before the surgeon says so?
faqs.a: Not safely. Every fit-to-fly is signed after a repeat check, and the quote includes that review — it is why most travel dates are not day seven.

faqs.q: Do you sell patient data or accept paid placement?
faqs.a: No. A hospital can pay for coordination after your case, and that fee is disclosed inside every quote you receive from us.

faqs.q: Will you coordinate a treatment you think is wrong for me?
faqs.a: No. If the review suggests surgery will not help, the coordinator tells you that and suggests the conservative path, even though it costs the platform less.

faqs.q: Do you accept every hospital that applies?
faqs.a: No. Every applicant is audited, and a meaningful share of audited candidates fail and are never listed.

faqs.q: How do you handle research and market data?
faqs.a: Benchmark figures are aggregated, published with their method and sample size, and never built from individual patient records.
